theme.title: Across the NBA
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 2001–02 Kings win?

funFacts.text: Sacramento acquired Mike Bibby from the Grizzlies before the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Kings acquired Mike Bibby from the Vancouver Grizzlies on draft day

funFacts.text: Chris Webber missed the first twenty games with an ankle injury.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chris Webber missing the first 20 games of the regular season

funFacts.text: The division title was the club's first since its Kansas City years.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: first division title since the 1978–79 season

questions.prompt: Andre Iguodala won 2015 Finals MVP. How many of the 11 votes did he get?
questions.note: Seven. The other four went to LeBron James of the losing Cavaliers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Iguodala received seven out 11 votes; the other four went to James

funFacts.text: Iguodala became the first Finals MVP to win the award without starting every game of the series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He became the first and only player to win the award without starting every game of the series

funFacts.text: Iguodala's main defensive job in the series was shadowing LeBron James, even as he supplied Golden State with scoring and playmaking.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Iguodala was also tasked with guarding Cleveland star LeBron James

funFacts.text: Kerr shifted Iguodala into the starting lineup for Game 4, with Draymond Green sliding to center.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kerr inserted Andre Iguodala into the starting lineup in place of Andrew Bogut, while moving Draymond Green to the center position

questions.prompt: What was Kyle Lowry's regular-season assists average for the champion Raptors?
questions.note: 8.7 assists per game from Toronto's lead guard.

funFacts.text: Lowry racked up 564 total assists during the regular season.
He started all 65 games in which he appeared that season.
Lowry handed out ten assists in the road victory that clinched Toronto's first title.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1998–99 Spurs win in the lockout season?
questions.note: 37, going 37–13, tied with Utah for the league’s best.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs finished in first place in the Midwest Division with a league-best 37–13 record

funFacts.text: The Spurs started slowly before tearing through March and the rest of the shortened schedule.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Spurs got off to a slow start to the regular season by posting a 6–8 record in February

funFacts.text: San Antonio added ex-Bulls sharpshooter Steve Kerr to its roster that summer.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: acquired three-point specialist Steve Kerr from the Chicago Bulls

funFacts.text: Tim Duncan earned All-Defensive First Team honors alongside his fellow frontcourt force David Robinson.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: was named to the All-NBA First Team, and to the NBA All-Defensive First Team

questions.prompt: Down 3–1 in the 2016 Finals, how many points did LeBron and Kyrie combine for in Game 5?
questions.context: LeBron James + Kyrie Irving · Cleveland · Finals 2016
questions.note: 82 combined. They became the first Finals teammates to each reach 40.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: James and Irving each scored 41 points to become the first teammates in Finals history to score 40 or more in the same game.
source.derivation: LeBron 41 + Kyrie 41 = 82 points combined, both figures in the cited sentence.

funFacts.text: They were the first Finals teammates with 40 points each.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first teammates in Finals history to score 40 or more in the same game

funFacts.text: LeBron also had 16 rebounds, seven assists and three blocks.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The former also added 16 rebounds, seven assists, three steals, and three blocks

funFacts.text: Draymond Green was suspended for Game 5.
